posts.body_html:
I’ll share some late additions.

My oreophila’s first pitcher in my care is popping up (I got it in the summer last year):


My alata flower opened up (but nothing else did at the same time, sadly — I did try selfing, though.)


Although it’s not a sarr, I thought I’d share this. This guy is a little VFT division I donated to the plant collection at my college. It was divided last spring and was maybe 1.5” across and spent all last year outside at home. Now, it’s in the greenhouse, is flowering size (I had to snip a flower this year), and is putting out great traps over 1” long!
